observations: At all three inspected frames, the streaming candidate severely changes the main cartoon character face/head geometry and loses identifiable facial features relative to GT.
Large smeared and ghost-like edges affect the main character, secondary character and room details; these are structural fidelity failures, beyond ordinary sharpening differences.
The bidirectional arm retains more of the original character identity and scene layout than the streaming arm, but changes outlines, textures and details relative to GT.
scope_limits: Three sampled frames only; no continuous temporal/flicker review has been performed.
This review does not identify the cause of the model failure.
The official overlap decoder remains provisional for strict streaming.
